ios.desc:
Take control of your finances with Budget Hound — your intelligent personal budgeting assistant. Whether you’re saving for something big or just want to track everyday spending, Budget Hound gives you the tools you need to manage your money with confidence.

• Daily Budget Planner: Get a personalized daily spending limit based on your income, expenses, and financial goals.
• Smart Budget Estimator: Automatically calculates and recommends monthly budgets tailored to your lifestyle.
• Advanced Analytics: Dive into clear, detailed insights to understand your spending habits and uncover saving opportunities.
• Effortless Tracking: Log expenses in seconds and see where your money goes in real-time.
• Custom Categories & Goals: Set specific goals and categorize spending to stay focused and organized.

Whether you’re budgeting for groceries or planning a long-term savings strategy, Budget Hound keeps you on track — every step of the way.
Download now and start mastering your money with ease.

Support: support@budgethound.app

Privacy policy: https://budgethound.app/privacy.pdf
Terms of Use: https://budgethound.app/terms.pdf
